context: A teacher and student discuss a political-history paper
purpose: Teach: 陣営/隠蔽/介助/接点/取り扱う/内臓/賛否/取り締まり

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 論文、戦時期の二陣営の対比、緻密ですね。
lines.en: Your paper is quite intricate — the way you've contrasted the two wartime factions.
lines.style: Genuine warmth in the opening. Measured pace. Lands on 「緻密」 with quiet approval. Leans slightly forward, eyes engaged but not intrusive.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。情報隠蔽の手口、史料に基づき扱いました。
lines.en: Yes. I grounded the information-suppression methods in primary sources throughout.
lines.style: Lean into the earnestness without overplaying it. Steady eye contact. Slight breathiness on 「基づき」 — he's relieved she's following. Composed but present.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦傷者の介助制度、それを取り扱う組織と当時の社会との接点もありますね。
lines.en: And you've also mapped the intersection between those wound-care systems, the organizations that ran them, and the broader society of the period.
lines.style: Thoughtful lift at the start. This isn't a yes-or-no — she's seeing the architecture of his argument. Warm precision. Slower pace. Inviting him to know she's tracking him.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 当時、解剖学的に内臓障害を扱う研究、限定的でした。
lines.en: The anatomical research into organ damage back then was quite limited — that's what made it so difficult to work with.
lines.style: Careful pause before he speaks. Quieter, more introspective than before. He's moved into deeper water. Slight hesitation, like he's testing whether this next thought holds.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 政治家の賛否、戦後の取り締まりにも影響しました。
lines.en: Politicians were split on it, and that division ended up shaping the crackdowns once the war was over.
lines.style: Pulling back slightly to the larger frame. Reflective, not didactic. Soft landing on the final thought — she's drawing a line, not making a pronouncement. Warm closure.
